# ESA ESTEC — Materials and Electrical Components Laboratory

## Snapshot

| | |
|---|---|
| **Country** | Netherlands |
| **City** | Noordwijk |
| **Tier** | Extended |
| **Primary ecosystem** | Space Thermal |
| **Unit** | [Materials & Electrical Components Laboratory (TEC Directorate)](https://technology.esa.int/lab/materials-electrical-components-laboratory) |



## Why it matters internationally

Every European spacecraft's thermal design depends on trusted α/ε values
for its surfaces. ESTEC's materials laboratory is where those
thermo-optical properties are measured and qualified against ECSS
standards, making it the institutional bridge between laboratory
emissivity measurement and flight hardware.

## Scope of activity

- **Quantities:** thermo-optical properties: emittance, reflectance, absorptance
- **Spectral range:** UV–VIS–NIR–IR
- **Methodology:** Thermo-optical characterization of spacecraft thermal-control materials per ECSS standards, with benchtop and portable instruments; includes studies of lunar-dust degradation of thermo-optical properties.

**Application domains:** spacecraft thermal control · material qualification per ECSS standards.
